passage.title: Technology in Everyday Life
passage.text:
Technology is now an important part of everyday life. People use different devices such as smartphones, computers, and tablets to study, work, and communicate. These devices make many activities faster and easier.

One important part of modern technology is digital information. Students can use digital books, videos, and websites to learn new things. They can also access information from many places without visiting a library. This makes education more convenient and accessible.

Another important innovation is artificial intelligence (AI). AI can help people find information, translate languages, and complete simple tasks. Some software programs use AI to give users useful suggestions. In schools, these programs can support students when they need help with their studies.

Technology can also connect people through a network. For example, students can communicate with teachers and classmates through an online network. Some companies use technology to automate simple tasks, which can save time.

However, technology also creates new problems. People need to think about cybersecurity when they use online services. Personal information may not always be safe. Therefore, users should choose secure passwords and be careful when sharing information online.

Technology has many benefits, but people should use it carefully. New innovations can improve our lives, but safe and responsible use is also important.

passage.title: Technology and the Future of Work
passage.text:
Technology is changing the way people work and communicate. In the past, many activities required people to complete every step themselves. Today, digital devices, software, and online networks allow people to work more quickly and communicate across long distances.

One major innovation is artificial intelligence. AI systems can process information and perform some tasks that previously required human workers. For example, an intelligent system can organize large amounts of information, answer simple questions, or help a company communicate with customers. These developments show how technological progress can change the workplace.

Another important development is the ability to automate routine tasks. Automation can save time and allow workers to focus on activities that require human skills, such as communication and creative thinking. However, automation may also create concerns. Some workers may need to learn new skills because certain jobs can change or become less common.

Digital technology also gives people greater access to information. A worker can attend a virtual meeting, read online documents, or use software from almost anywhere. This accessibility can be useful for people who live far from large cities. However, easy access also means that people must understand cybersecurity. Personal and company information needs to remain secure.

Software is another important part of technological development. A useful application can help workers organize their schedules, communicate with colleagues, or manage information. As software becomes more advanced, programmers and other technology workers are required to create and improve these programs.

Despite these advantages, technology does not solve every problem. A new device may be useful, but it can be expensive. An advanced system may save time, but workers may need training before they can use it effectively. Therefore, technological advancement should be considered carefully.

The future will probably include even more digital tools and intelligent systems. The most useful approach is not simply to accept every new invention. Instead, individuals and organizations should consider how an innovation can provide real benefits, improve productivity, and keep information secure. Technology can be powerful, but its value depends on how people use it.

passage.title: Technology at School
passage.transcript:
Today, I would like to talk about technology in schools. Many students now use a device, such as a tablet or laptop, to study. These devices give students access to digital books, videos, and other learning materials.

One useful innovation is artificial intelligence. An AI system can help students find information or practise a language. For example, some software programs can give students simple feedback on their work.

Technology can also connect students through a school network. Students can share information with teachers and classmates without being in the same room. In some schools, technology is also used to automate simple activities, such as recording attendance.

There are several benefits to using technology at school. Students can access learning materials at different times, and teachers can provide information more quickly. However, there are also some risks. One important issue is cybersecurity. Students should use strong passwords and avoid sharing personal information with strangers online.

Technology is developing quickly, so schools need to think carefully about how they use it. New tools can be useful, but students and teachers should learn how to use them safely. With good planning, technology can support learning and make education more accessible.
